Qwen's August-2026 flagship open-weight DENSE model, apache-2.0. Hybrid attention: 64 layers = 48 Gated-DeltaNet linear-attention + 16 full-attention, full_attention_interval 4, attn_output_gate, partial/mRoPE, MTP head, vision tower unused in text-only decode. Same qwen3_5 family as row 8, whose MoE cell already drives the GDN path. Guard envelope 85 GB footprint / 95 GB RSS against 55.6 GB of bf16 weights. CPU measured infeasible 2026-09-01: 55.6 GB of bf16 weights plus the checkpoint's page cache reaches ~116 GB of 128, and two guarded attempts (the second throttled to 0.4 GB/s) were killed during the load at RSS 101.4 / 100.3 GB with the free list at 0.1 / 0.8 GB.
